{{Quote|Hm... silly title for a place emitting an unnatural evil. I approached the monument quietly, having seen the glimmer of a dark figure in the distance. A lone man, silhouetted by the birth of night, stood quietly, staring at the altar for quite some time.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (2/8)}}</ref>}}
The '''Altar of Evil''' was the name given by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] to an ancient shrine located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Altar had been built at the site of a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Anybody visiting the place could feel its unnatural evil upon approaching the altar.<ref name="SWG:AEL" /> The shrine was made of one large stone surrounded by three statues and decorated by one skull above an inscription in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Lesser Prophet]] [[Prophets of the Dark Side|of the Dark Side]] spent most of his time meditating at the Altar of Evil.<ref name="SWG" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tinrilo x'Rilsam discovered the altar while exploring Naboo. However, the explorer afraid by the evil presence of the Altar and by the dark prophet decided to not push his exploration forward.<ref name="SWG:AEL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Altar of Evil was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Altar of Evil was one of many unmarked points of interests on the planet Naboo.<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' expansion pack in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] during space battles. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (2/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the Dark Prophet and the Altar of Evil.<ref name="SWG:AEL" />

The text in Aurebesh at the altar read "House Signs".<ref name="SWG" />
